pages.title: Shipping & Delivery
intro: Welcome to Orvexo Electronics, operated legally under Universal Lighting Technologies. We are committed to providing a reliable, transparent, and convenient shopping experience for customers across the United States.

This Shipping Policy explains how we process, prepare, ship, and deliver orders placed through our official website, https://orvexo.us. It includes important information about shipping costs, order processing, estimated delivery times, tracking, address accuracy, shipping delays, and assistance with lost or damaged packages.
We encourage all customers to review this policy before placing an order.
All prices, shipping charges, and order totals mentioned in this policy are expressed in United States Dollars (USD).
pages.description: Welcome to Orvexo Electronics, operated legally under Universal Lighting Technologies. We are committed to providing a reliable, transparent, and convenient shopping experience for customers across the United States.

blocks.text: Orvexo Electronics currently ships eligible electronics, electronic accessories, and related products to residential and commercial addresses within the United States.
Our standard shipping service covers eligible domestic delivery addresses supported by our shipping carriers.
Current Shipping Coverage:

items: U.S. Territories: Not currently supported unless specifically confirmed at checkout
P.O. Boxes: Subject to carrier and product eligibility
APO/FPO Addresses: Subject to carrier availability and product restrictions

blocks.text: Certain products, including oversized electronics, battery-powered devices, or items subject to carrier restrictions, may have additional shipping limitations.
If your address is not eligible for delivery, our checkout system may prevent the order from being completed, or our customer support team may contact you to discuss available options.
We may expand our shipping coverage in the future and will update this policy accordingly.
We believe customers should know their shipping costs before completing a purchase.
Orvexo Electronics offers:
Standard Shipping: FREE ($0.00 USD)
Free standard shipping applies to all eligible domestic orders placed through our website.
There is no minimum purchase amount required to qualify for free standard shipping.
Shipping Cost Summary
The final order total, including any applicable taxes, will be displayed during checkout before payment is submitted.
We do not add unexpected standard shipping charges after an order has been placed.
Our daily order cut-off time is 4:00 PM Central Time (CT).
Orders placed before 4:00 PM CT on a regular business day are typically queued to begin processing on the same day.
Orders placed after the cut-off time will begin processing on the next available business day.
Orders submitted on Saturdays, Sundays, or recognized public holidays will also be queued for processing on the next business day.
Example:

items: Order placed Monday at 2:00 PM CT: Typically begins processing Monday.
Order placed Monday at 6:00 PM CT: Typically begins processing Tuesday.
Order placed Saturday: Typically begins processing Monday, excluding holidays.

blocks.text: Our standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time.
Central Time automatically observes Central Standard Time (CST) or Central Daylight Time (CDT), depending on the season.
Orders placed through Orvexo Electronics are typically processed within 1–2 business days after successful payment confirmation.
Processing time refers to the period required to prepare your order before it is handed over to the shipping carrier.
During this period, our fulfillment process may include:

items: Picking and inspecting the ordered items.
Transferring the package to the designated carrier.

blocks.text: Our team takes reasonable precautions when packaging electronics to reduce the risk of damage during transit.
Processing Delays
Processing may occasionally take longer during:
If a significant processing delay affects your order, we will make reasonable efforts to notify you using the contact information provided during checkout.
After your order has been processed and handed over to the shipping carrier, standard transit typically takes 3–7 business days.
Actual delivery times depend on several factors, including:
Customers in remote locations may experience delivery times toward the longer end of the estimated range.
Transit time begins after the carrier receives the shipment, not when the order is initially placed.
Our estimated delivery time includes both order processing and shipping transit.
Most orders are expected to arrive within 4–9 business days from the date the order is placed, subject to the daily cut-off time and applicable holidays.
These delivery estimates are provided as general guidance and are not guaranteed delivery dates.
If we cannot ship your order within the timeframe required by applicable law or an agreed shipping commitment, we will provide the required notice and available cancellation or refund options.

sections.title: 7. What Counts as a Business Day?

blocks.text: For the purposes of order processing and estimated delivery calculations, business days generally refer to:
Monday – Friday, excluding recognized public holidays.
Our business operating hours are:
9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time (CT)
Saturdays, Sundays, and recognized public holidays are excluded from our standard order-processing calculations.
Shipping carriers may operate under different schedules, including limited weekend services. Carrier-specific delivery activity does not change our standard business-day estimates.
Orvexo Electronics works with established shipping providers to deliver orders across the United States.
Depending on your destination, package size, product characteristics, and operational requirements, orders may be shipped through:
We select the shipping carrier best suited to the destination and shipment requirements.
Customers cannot always select a specific carrier during checkout.
We do not guarantee that every shipment will be handled by a particular shipping provider.
We provide tracking information for shipped orders so customers can monitor their deliveries.
Once your package has been handed over to the shipping carrier, you will typically receive a shipping confirmation email containing:
Tracking information is generally emailed within 24–48 hours after carrier pickup.
Tracking Updates
Tracking information may not update immediately after the shipping label is created.
Carriers sometimes require additional time to scan packages into their systems.
If your tracking number does not display information immediately, please allow time for the carrier's tracking system to update.
If you have not received tracking information within the expected timeframe, contact:
info@orvexo.us
Our 24/7 Live Chat support is also available to assist with tracking inquiries.
Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete shipping information during checkout.
Please verify the following details before submitting your order:
Incorrect or incomplete shipping information may result in delivery delays, failed delivery attempts, or packages being returned to the sender.
Incorrect Shipping Addresses
If a package is returned because of an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer, additional shipping charges may apply if the customer requests reshipment.
Any applicable reshipping fee will be communicated before a replacement shipment is arranged.
If the delivery problem resulted from an error made by Orvexo Electronics, we will work to correct the issue without charging the customer for our mistake.
If you need to change your shipping address after placing an order, please contact our customer support team immediately.
We will attempt to accommodate address changes while the order is still awaiting fulfillment.
However, once an order has entered fulfillment or has been transferred to the shipping carrier, address changes may no longer be possible.
Any available carrier rerouting options may depend on the shipping provider and shipment status.
We cannot guarantee successful address modifications after dispatch.
Customers may request order changes or cancellations before an order enters fulfillment.
If you wish to cancel an order, please contact us as soon as possible.
Before Fulfillment
Cancellation requests received before fulfillment begins may be approved.
During Fulfillment
Once an order has entered fulfillment, cancellation or modification may no longer be possible.
After Shipment
Orders that have already shipped generally cannot be canceled.
If you no longer want the product after delivery, you may request a return in accordance with our Return and Refund Policy.
Please review our Return and Refund Policy for eligibility requirements and instructions.
If your order contains multiple products, some items may occasionally be shipped separately.
Split shipments may occur due to:
When an order is shipped in multiple packages, the packages may arrive on different dates.
Separate tracking information will be provided for each shipment where applicable.
Standard domestic shipping remains free for eligible orders even when multiple shipments are required.
We make reasonable efforts to process and dispatch orders within our published timeframes.
However, shipping delays may occasionally occur due to circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
These may include:
If we become aware of a significant delay affecting your order, we will make reasonable efforts to keep you informed.
If your shipment is delayed beyond the expected timeframe, please contact our support team so we can investigate.
Applicable statutory rights concerning delayed or undelivered orders remain unaffected.
If your tracking information shows that your package has been delivered but you cannot locate it, please follow these steps:

items: Check around your delivery location, including your porch, mailbox, garage, side entrance, or building reception area.
Ask household members, neighbors, or building management whether they accepted the package.
Review the carrier's tracking information for delivery notes or photographs.
Allow up to 24 hours in case the carrier's delivery scan was recorded before the package was physically dropped off.
If the package is still missing, contact our customer support team.

blocks.text: Our team will assist you in reviewing the delivery information and, where appropriate, opening an investigation with the shipping carrier.
Any applicable refund or replacement will be determined in accordance with our Return and Refund Policy and applicable consumer protection laws.
A carrier's delivered status does not automatically eliminate rights or remedies available under applicable law.
If your shipment appears to be lost during transit, please contact us at:
info@orvexo.us
We will review the tracking history and may initiate an investigation with the responsible shipping carrier.
During the investigation, we may request:
Once the investigation is completed, we will determine the appropriate resolution.
Depending on the circumstances, this may include:

items: Locating and delivering the original package

blocks.text: All resolutions will be handled in accordance with applicable law and our Return and Refund Policy.
We take reasonable precautions when packaging electronics to protect products during transportation.
However, damage may occasionally occur while a package is in transit.
If your order arrives damaged, please contact us as soon as possible, preferably within 48 hours of delivery.
To help us investigate, please provide:

items: Clear photographs of the damaged product
Photographs of the outer shipping packaging
Photographs of any visible damage to the shipping box
A brief description of the issue

blocks.text: Please retain the original packaging and accessories until our support team provides further instructions.
We will review the claim and provide an appropriate resolution under our Return and Refund Policy.
The 48-hour notification period is intended to help us investigate shipping damage promptly and does not remove any non-waivable statutory rights.
Packages may occasionally be returned to the sender because:

items: The address is invalid or inaccessible.
The carrier cannot complete delivery after reasonable attempts.
The package is not collected when required.

blocks.text: If a package is returned to us through no fault of Orvexo Electronics, any applicable refund will be handled according to our Return and Refund Policy.
Additional reshipping charges may apply if the customer requests another delivery attempt after an address-related return.
Where a delivery failure results from our error, we will provide an appropriate resolution without imposing charges caused by that error.
Certain electronics products may be subject to additional transportation requirements due to their size, weight, battery composition, or other characteristics.
These may include:

items: Items restricted by individual shipping carriers

blocks.text: Where relevant, product-specific shipping restrictions will be disclosed before purchase or communicated if an unexpected restriction is identified during fulfillment.
We will not impose undisclosed additional shipping charges without obtaining the customer's agreement.
To maintain a secure shopping environment, certain orders may require additional verification before dispatch.
Verification may be necessary when:

items: Billing and shipping information differ significantly.
A payment transaction is flagged for review.
An order contains unusually high-value items.
An order displays potentially fraudulent activity.
Additional confirmation is required by the payment provider.

blocks.text: If verification is required, our support team may contact the customer using the information provided during checkout.
We will not request payment card security codes or account passwords through email or live chat.
Verification requirements may occasionally affect processing times.
If you are dissatisfied with an eligible product after delivery, Orvexo Electronics offers a 30-calendar-day return window beginning on the date the carrier marks the order as delivered.
Products must generally be unused, uninstalled, and in their original condition with the required packaging and accessories.
Return Shipping Charges

items: Damaged, defective, or incorrect products: Free prepaid return shipping after verification.
Change-of-mind returns: Customer is responsible for return shipping charges.

blocks.text: Approved refunds are typically processed within 10 business days after the returned item has been received and inspected.
For full details, please review our Return and Refund Policy.
Orvexo Electronics may update this Shipping Policy periodically to reflect changes in:
Any updates will be published on this page with a revised Last Updated date.
Changes will generally apply to future orders and will not retroactively alter shipping commitments already agreed upon, except where permitted by law.
We encourage customers to review this policy before placing an order.
For additional information about shopping with Orvexo Electronics, please visit:
These policies provide additional information about purchasing, payment processing, returns, refunds, and customer rights.
If you have questions about shipping costs, order processing, delivery estimates, tracking, delayed packages, or this Shipping Policy, our customer support team is available to assist you.

intro: At Orvexo Electronics, operated legally under Universal Lighting Technologies, customer satisfaction is one of our priorities. We want every customer to shop confidently, knowing that our return and refund procedures are transparent, straightforward, and fair.

This Return and Refund Policy explains the eligibility requirements, return conditions, shipping responsibilities, refund processing times, and procedures for returning products purchased through our official website, https://orvexo.us.

Whether you receive a damaged product, encounter a manufacturing defect, receive an incorrect item, or simply change your mind, this policy outlines the available options and the steps required to request assistance.
We encourage customers to review this policy before placing an order.
All prices, fees, and refund amounts mentioned throughout this policy are expressed in United States Dollars (USD).
pages.description: At Orvexo Electronics, operated legally under Universal Lighting Technologies, customer satisfaction is one of our priorities. We want every customer to shop confidently, knowing that our return and refund procedures are transparent, straightforward, and fair.

blocks.text: Orvexo Electronics offers a 30-calendar-day return window for eligible products purchased directly from our website.
The return period begins on the date your order is marked as delivered by the shipping carrier.
Customers must contact our support team to request return authorization within 30 calendar days of delivery.
Return Policy Summary

rows.label: Return Eligibility
rows.value: Unused, uninstalled products in original condition

rows.label: Refund Processing
rows.value: Within 10 business days after inspection and approval

blocks.text: Return requests submitted after the 30-day window may not qualify for a standard return unless an exception is required by applicable law or an applicable warranty.
Customers may request a return for several reasons, provided the product meets the applicable eligibility requirements.
2.1 Change of Mind
If you decide that a purchased product is no longer suitable for your needs, you may request a return within 30 calendar days of delivery.
The product must remain unused, uninstalled, and in its original condition, with all required packaging and accessories.
For change-of-mind returns, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs.
2.2 Damaged Products
If a product arrives damaged during shipping, please contact our support team as soon as possible, preferably within 48 hours of delivery.
We may request photographs of the product and shipping packaging to help investigate the damage.
Where the issue is verified, we will provide an appropriate resolution and a prepaid return shipping label if a return is required.
2.3 Defective or Malfunctioning Products
If your product arrives defective or fails to function as expected, please contact our support team with your order details and a description of the issue.
Our team may request photographs, videos, or other reasonable information to assess the reported defect.
Verified defective products may qualify for a refund, replacement, or another appropriate remedy under this policy, applicable warranties, and consumer protection laws.
2.4 Incorrect Products
If you receive a product that differs from the item or model you ordered, please notify us promptly.
After verification, we will arrange an appropriate resolution without charging you return shipping costs for our error.
2.5 Missing Components or Accessories
If your order arrives without an accessory or component that should have been included, please contact our support team.
Depending on the circumstances, we may arrange shipment of the missing component or offer another appropriate resolution.
To qualify for a standard change-of-mind return, the product must meet the following requirements:

items: The return must be requested within 30 calendar days of delivery.
The item must be unused and uninstalled.
The product must remain in its original condition.
The original packaging must be included.
All manuals, cables, adapters, mounting hardware, and included accessories must be returned.
The product must not show damage caused by misuse, improper handling, or unauthorized modification.
The return must include proof of purchase or a valid Orvexo Electronics order number.
Return authorization must be obtained before shipping the product.

blocks.text: Products that do not meet these conditions may be ineligible for a full change-of-mind refund.
These requirements do not remove any statutory rights or remedies relating to defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied products.
We aim to make the return process as clear and convenient as possible.
Step 1: Contact Customer Support
Contact us within the applicable return window using either of the following methods:
Please include:

items: Email address associated with the order
Photographs or supporting information, if applicable

blocks.text: Step 2: Return Request Review
Our customer support team will review your request and determine whether the product qualifies for a return.
We may request additional information where reasonably necessary.
Step 3: Receive Return Authorization
Once your return is approved, we will provide:

items: A prepaid shipping label, if applicable
Additional packaging or handling instructions, if required

blocks.text: Important: Do not send products directly to our business address without receiving return authorization.
The correct return destination may differ from our registered business address.
Step 4: Package Your Return
Carefully package the item to reduce the risk of damage during transportation.
Include the original packaging, manuals, accessories, and other components supplied with the product.
Step 5: Ship Your Return
Send the package to the designated return address provided by our customer support team.
We strongly recommend using a tracked shipping service.
Step 6: Return Inspection
Once the package arrives at the designated return facility, our team will inspect the product and verify its condition.
Step 7: Refund Confirmation
After inspection, we will notify you by email whether your refund has been approved, declined, or requires further review.
Approved refunds will be processed according to the timelines described below.
Return shipping responsibility depends on the reason for the return.
5.1 Defective, Damaged, or Incorrect Products
If a return is required because of an error attributable to Orvexo Electronics or a verified product defect, we will provide a prepaid return shipping label at no additional cost.
Examples include:
Customers should notify us promptly, preferably within 48 hours of delivery, and provide supporting photographs where available.
5.2 Change-of-Mind Returns
If you return a product because you changed your mind, ordered the wrong item, or no longer need it, you are responsible for return shipping costs.
The shipping cost will depend on the carrier, package size, weight, and return destination.
5.3 Original Shipping Charges
Orvexo Electronics offers free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders.
As standard shipping is provided at no charge, there is generally no original standard shipping fee to refund.
5.4 Return Shipping Insurance
For customer-paid returns, we recommend using a tracked and appropriately insured shipping service, particularly for high-value electronics.
If a return package is lost in transit, please contact the carrier and our support team with the tracking information.
Refund eligibility will be evaluated based on the available shipment evidence and applicable law.
Orvexo Electronics does not charge restocking fees on approved returns.
Restocking Fee: $0.00 USD
We do not impose a separate restocking or handling fee simply because an eligible product is returned.
However, change-of-mind return shipping costs remain the customer's responsibility.
Certain products may not qualify for a standard return if they do not meet our eligibility requirements.
Examples include:

items: Products installed, wired, altered, or modified after delivery
Products damaged through misuse or improper installation
Items showing significant wear or customer-caused damage
Products missing essential original components or accessories
Products returned without required proof of purchase
Return requests submitted after the applicable return window
Gift cards or downloadable promotional items, where applicable

blocks.text: For electronics, damage resulting from incompatible power supplies, unauthorized modifications, or improper electrical installation may affect return eligibility.
Important: These exclusions apply to standard returns and do not override applicable legal rights concerning defective products, incorrect orders, or other legally protected claims.
All returned products may undergo inspection after arriving at the designated return facility.
Our inspection process may include:

items: Verifying the returned product and order number
Confirming the presence of original accessories
Reviewing signs of installation or modification
Confirming compliance with the applicable return conditions

blocks.text: After the inspection, we will notify you of the outcome.
If your return is approved, the refund process will begin.
If the return does not meet the applicable conditions, we will explain the reason and any available options.
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used during checkout.
We do not normally redirect refunds to unrelated bank accounts, third-party cards, or alternative payment methods.
9.1 Refund Approval
Once a returned item is received and inspected, our team will determine whether the refund qualifies for approval.
You will receive an email notification confirming the outcome.
9.2 Refund Processing Time
Approved refunds are typically processed within 10 business days after the returned item has been received, inspected, and approved.
9.3 Bank and Payment Provider Processing
After we issue a refund, your financial institution or payment provider may require additional time to post the funds to your account.
Actual posting times depend on the payment method and provider.
9.4 Refund Currency
Refunds are issued in United States Dollars (USD), consistent with the original transaction.
If your payment provider converted the transaction into another currency, exchange-rate differences or provider fees may affect the final amount credited.

sections.title: 10. Refunds to the Original Payment Method

blocks.text: For security and fraud prevention, refunds are generally returned to the payment method used for the original purchase.
If the original card has expired, been replaced, or is no longer active, the payment provider may still be able to route the refund to the associated account.
If you experience difficulty receiving a refund, please contact your bank or payment provider and our customer support team.
Any alternative refund arrangement must comply with applicable payment processing requirements and law.

sections.title: 11. If Your Refund Has Not Arrived

blocks.text: If 10 business days have passed since your refund confirmation email and you have not received the funds, please follow these steps:

items: Check your bank account or payment statement again.
Contact your card issuer or payment provider to ask whether the refund is pending.
Confirm whether additional processing time is required by your financial institution.
Contact our support team at info@orvexo.us if you still need assistance.

blocks.text: Please include your order number and refund confirmation details so we can investigate efficiently.

items: Minor condition differences disclosed during inspection

blocks.text: Any proposed partial refund will be explained to the customer before it is finalized.
Partial refunds will not be used to reduce remedies that customers are legally entitled to receive for defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied products.
Orvexo Electronics does not currently offer direct product exchanges.
If you would like a different model, color, specification, or product, you may:

items: Request a return for the original eligible product.
Place a new order for the desired product through https://orvexo.us.

sections.title: 2. When Can an Order Be Canceled?

blocks.text: An order can generally be canceled if it has not yet entered fulfillment.
2.1 Orders Awaiting Processing
If your order is still awaiting processing, we may be able to cancel it before fulfillment begins.
Please contact our support team as soon as possible.
2.2 Orders Being Processed
Once an order enters fulfillment, it may no longer be possible to stop the preparation or dispatch process.
Our team will review the order status and advise whether cancellation remains possible.
2.3 Orders Already Shipped
Once a package has been handed over to the shipping carrier, the order generally cannot be canceled.
If you no longer want the product, you may request a return after delivery under our Return and Refund Policy.
If you wish to cancel your order, please follow these steps.
Step 1 — Contact Customer Support
Reach out to us immediately through:
Step 2 — Provide Your Order Information
Please include:

items: Product name or items to be canceled
Reason for cancellation, if you wish to provide one

blocks.text: Step 3 — Order Status Verification
Our team will check whether the order has entered fulfillment or been shipped.
Step 4 — Cancellation Confirmation
If cancellation is possible, we will confirm the cancellation and provide information about any applicable refund.
If cancellation is no longer possible, we will explain the available return options.
A cancellation is confirmed only when you receive confirmation from Orvexo Electronics.
Orvexo Electronics does not charge a separate order cancellation fee for an approved cancellation.
Cancellation Fee: $0.00 USD

Any applicable financing charges or adjustments imposed independently by a third-party payment provider are governed by that provider's agreement and applicable law.
If your order is successfully canceled after payment has been collected, we will initiate the applicable refund to the original payment method.
Refund Method
Refunds are generally issued through the same payment method used to complete the purchase.
Refund Processing
For an approved cancellation, we will initiate the refund promptly after cancellation confirmation and payment verification.
The time required for funds to appear in your account may vary depending on your bank, card issuer, or payment provider.
Payment Authorizations
If a transaction was authorized but not captured, the payment provider may release the authorization rather than issue a separate refund.
The time required for the authorization to disappear from your account depends on the financial institution.

sections.title: 6. Cancellations for Afterpay and Affirm Orders

blocks.text: Customers who use Buy Now, Pay Later services may also request cancellation before fulfillment.

Afterpay Orders

Afterpay will determine how the cancellation affects any installments already collected or scheduled.
Affirm Orders
If an Affirm-funded order is successfully canceled, the applicable refund or adjustment will be processed through Affirm.

At Orvexo Electronics, operated by Universal Lighting Technologies, we understand that purchasing electronics is an investment in your everyday life.
We want customers to feel confident when choosing our products and to understand what support may be available if a product develops a problem.

This Warranty Information page explains manufacturer warranty coverage, eligibility requirements, warranty claims, product defects, exclusions, and how to request assistance for products purchased through our official website, https://orvexo.us.
Because electronics vary by manufacturer, model, and product category, warranty terms may differ between products.

Important: A manufacturer warranty is not automatically included with every product. Any applicable warranty period, coverage, and conditions are determined by the warranty provided for the specific product. Orvexo Electronics does not offer a separate universal store warranty unless expressly stated in writing.

sections.title: 1. Our Approach to Product Warranty Support

blocks.text: We aim to provide clear product information and help customers understand their available warranty options.
Our approach includes:

items: Providing available manufacturer warranty information where applicable.
Helping customers identify the appropriate warranty claim process.
Assisting with questions about products purchased through our store.
Reviewing reports of defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied products.
Honoring our published return and refund conditions.
Respecting applicable consumer protection and warranty laws.

blocks.text: Warranty assistance depends on the product, manufacturer, purchase circumstances, and applicable legal requirements.
Some products sold by Orvexo Electronics may include a limited warranty provided by the manufacturer.
A manufacturer warranty may cover certain defects in materials or workmanship that arise during normal use within the applicable warranty period.
Coverage may include, depending on the manufacturer's terms:

items: Product failures covered by the manufacturer's warranty
Repair or replacement of qualifying defective components

blocks.text: The manufacturer determines the actual coverage, duration, exclusions, and available remedies.
Warranty Duration
Warranty periods may vary depending on the product and manufacturer.
For example, some electronics may have limited warranty periods of several months or one year, while other products may have different coverage or no manufacturer warranty.
These examples are illustrative and do not establish a warranty period for any product sold by Orvexo Electronics.
Customers should review the specific product listing, included documentation, or manufacturer's warranty statement for applicable coverage.

sections.title: 3. How to Check Whether Your Product Has a Warranty

blocks.text: Before purchasing a product, customers should review the product description and available specifications.
Warranty information, where provided, may appear in:

items: Warranty cards included in the package
Additional information supplied by our support team

blocks.text: If you cannot find warranty information for a product, contact us before purchasing.
Our team will help clarify available warranty information where it can be verified.

sections.title: 4. What a Manufacturer Warranty May Cover

blocks.text: Depending on the specific warranty agreement, eligible claims may include:
Manufacturing Defects
Problems resulting from defects in materials, components, or manufacturing processes.
Hardware Malfunctions
Covered hardware failures that occur during normal use within the warranty period.
Defective Components
Certain components that fail under conditions covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
Product Performance Issues
Qualifying performance problems caused by a covered manufacturing defect rather than misuse, normal wear, or incompatible accessories.
The manufacturer's written warranty determines which conditions qualify.
Manufacturer warranties commonly include exclusions.
Depending on the specific product and warranty terms, exclusions may include:

items: Cosmetic damage unrelated to a covered defect
Damage caused by external electrical surges
Damage resulting from use contrary to manufacturer instructions

blocks.text: These are general examples. Actual exclusions depend on the manufacturer's warranty and applicable law.
Nothing in this section removes statutory rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded.
If a product purchased from Orvexo Electronics develops a problem, follow the steps below.
Step 1 — Contact Our Support Team
Email info@orvexo.us or use our 24/7 live chat.
Please include:

items: Relevant photographs or videos, where available

blocks.text: Step 2 — Initial Review
Our support team will review your information and may request additional details to better understand the issue.
We may ask you to confirm the product model, serial number, or troubleshooting steps already attempted.
Step 3 — Warranty Verification
Where applicable, we will help identify whether manufacturer warranty coverage may be available.
The manufacturer may require proof of purchase, product registration, or other documentation.
Step 4 — Claim Instructions
Depending on the manufacturer's process, you may be directed to an authorized warranty service provider or given other applicable claim instructions.
Step 5 — Claim Resolution
If a warranty claim is accepted, the manufacturer or responsible service provider will determine the available remedy under the warranty agreement.
Possible remedies may include repair, replacement, or another remedy specified by the warranty.
Please do not ship products to our business address or an unverified service location without receiving appropriate instructions.

sections.title: 7. Warranty Claims Within the First 30 Days

blocks.text: If a product arrives defective, damaged, or incorrect, you may be eligible for assistance under our standard Return and Refund Policy.
Orvexo Electronics offers a 30-calendar-day return window for eligible products, beginning on the date of delivery.
For verified defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied products, we provide a prepaid return shipping label when a return is required.
We encourage customers to report visible shipping damage or delivery-related issues within 48 hours so we can investigate promptly.
This reporting recommendation does not restrict any non-waivable legal rights.
For full information, review our Return and Refund Policy.
If a product develops a problem after the standard 30-day return window, warranty assistance may still be available.
The available options depend on:

items: Whether the product includes a manufacturer warranty
Whether the warranty period remains active
Whether the reported issue is covered
Whether the product meets warranty eligibility conditions

blocks.text: Our customer support team can assist with available information and direct you toward the relevant claim procedure where appropriate.
Expiration of the standard return window does not automatically eliminate any applicable manufacturer warranty or statutory remedy.
Proof of purchase may be required when submitting a warranty claim.
Acceptable documentation may include:

items: Other documentation accepted by the manufacturer

blocks.text: Customers should retain their purchase records for future reference.
If you cannot locate your order confirmation, contact us at info@orvexo.us.
We may be able to help locate the order using the information associated with the purchase.
Some manufacturers may require a product serial number or registration details to process a warranty claim.
If applicable, customers should retain:
Warranty registration requirements vary.
Failure to register a product does not necessarily eliminate warranty coverage or statutory rights; the applicable terms and law determine the effect.
If a manufacturer approves a warranty claim, the available resolution may include:

items: Replacing the product with an eligible equivalent
Providing another remedy under the warranty terms

blocks.text: Repair or replacement availability depends on the manufacturer's procedures, product availability, and applicable law.
Replacement products may be new, refurbished, or equivalent where expressly permitted by the applicable warranty and law.
Orvexo Electronics does not guarantee a specific manufacturer remedy unless we have expressly agreed to provide it.
Shipping, inspection, repair, and replacement costs depend on the applicable warranty agreement.
Some manufacturer warranties may cover eligible service costs, while others may require the customer to pay certain shipping or handling expenses.
Any applicable charges should be disclosed by the responsible provider.
For verified defective, damaged, or incorrect products returned under our standard Return and Refund Policy, Orvexo Electronics provides prepaid return shipping where a return is required.
We do not impose additional charges that conflict with applicable statutory warranty rights.
Electronic accessories may have warranty conditions different from those of the primary device.
Examples include:
Warranty availability depends on the specific item and manufacturer.
Customers should not assume that accessories have the same warranty duration as the main product.
To reduce the risk of product damage and maintain applicable warranty eligibility, customers should follow the manufacturer's instructions.
We recommend:

items: Using compatible power supplies and accessories.
Protecting electronics from excessive heat and moisture.
Keeping products within specified operating conditions.

blocks.text: For products requiring electrical wiring or specialized installation, a qualified professional should perform the work where required by applicable law or safety standards.
Improper use may affect manufacturer warranty coverage, but it does not automatically eliminate legal rights unrelated to the misuse.
If you received a product purchased from Orvexo Electronics as a gift, warranty assistance may be available depending on the manufacturer's terms.
The manufacturer may require proof of purchase, the original order information, or other documentation.
Please contact our support team with the available purchase details.
We will help identify the appropriate next steps where possible.
Not every product sold through our website necessarily includes a manufacturer warranty.
If a product does not have an applicable manufacturer warranty, that does not remove any legal protections that may apply to defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied goods.
Customers should review product information carefully and contact us with questions before purchasing.
We will not describe a product as covered by a manufacturer warranty unless such coverage can be supported.
Unless expressly stated in writing for a particular product, Orvexo Electronics does not provide a separate, store-wide extended warranty or protection plan.
We do not guarantee:

items: A universal one-year warranty on all products

blocks.text: Any product-specific warranty promises will be governed by the terms disclosed for that product.
Nothing in this page excludes or limits express warranties, implied warranties, or consumer rights that cannot legally be disclaimed.

blocks.question: Do all Orvexo Electronics products come with a warranty?
blocks.answer: Not necessarily. Manufacturer warranty coverage varies by product. Check the product listing or contact customer support for available information.

blocks.answer: No. We do not offer a universal one-year warranty unless explicitly stated for a particular product.

blocks.answer: Contact us as soon as possible, preferably within 48 hours of delivery, and provide your order number and photographs of the damage.

blocks.question: Do I need the original packaging for a warranty claim?
blocks.answer: Requirements vary by manufacturer. We recommend retaining the original packaging and documentation whenever possible.

blocks.question: Can I request a refund instead of a warranty repair?
blocks.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the applicable return policy, warranty terms, and legal rights. A refund is not automatically available for every manufacturer warranty claim.

blocks.question: Who pays shipping costs for warranty repairs?
blocks.answer: The applicable manufacturer warranty determines the standard shipping responsibilities, subject to applicable law.

blocks.question: Can I return a defective product during the first 30 days?
blocks.answer: Yes. Eligible defective products may qualify for assistance under our Return and Refund Policy.

blocks.question: Can I send a warranty product to your Madison, Alabama address?
blocks.answer: No. Do not send products to our business address without receiving specific authorization and shipping instructions.

blocks.question: How can I contact your warranty support team?
blocks.answer: Email info@orvexo.us, call +1 (256) 772-8820 during business hours, or use our 24/7 live chat.
